messages:
ana (sales): Hey team — NovaBank SIG due EOD Tue. They're on a tight timeline for procurement. I created a question-by-question sheet and highlighted high-priority items. Can security own Q12 (encryption at rest) and Q34 (KMS/rotation)? SRE please grab Q78 (availability/DR). I'll coordinate POC artifacts and an index for delivery.

rebecca (solutions): I can attach the POC network diagram + sample config snippets. Uploading to GDrive now: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A_NovaBankSIG (restricted)

mike-sec (security): Assigning myself Q12 & Q34. For Q12 we have SOC2 excerpt + storage config screenshots; will redact usernames and tenant IDs. ETA tomorrow morning. Also suggest artifact naming: `nova_Q{num}_{artifact}_v{1}.pdf` to keep the ZIP tidy.

ben (sre): Taking Q78. I'll pull the runbook, SLA dashboard exports, and a sanitized latency graph. Dedicated capacity incident history included where relevant. Vault pointer for infra artifacts: https://vault.internal.company/secrets/infra/nova (access request required).

audrey (sales-eng): Small pricing note: prospect asked for throughput tier examples alongside controls. Do we include pricing in the SIG package or separate?

mike-sec (security): Don't include raw pricing in compliance artifacts. Add a single line in the index: "pricing discussed separately with AM" and route price docs through commercial. Keeps evidence package clean.

rebecca (solutions): Uploaded network diagram and POC run logs: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1abc123example — files use naming conv: `nova_Q12_network-diagram_v1.png` and `nova_poc_runlog_20250410.txt`.

compliance-bot: Reminder: SOC2 attestation must be the latest version number listed in the evidence spreadsheet. Please upload `SOC2_attestation_v{year}.pdf` under `evidence/sig/novabank/` before 2025-04-15 to avoid delays.

ana (sales): Great — can we get a single ZIP named `nova_SIG_package_20250414.zip` with an index mapping Q -> artifact? I'll verify and send to the customer once security signs off.

mike-sec (security): Uploaded Q12 evidence (encryption config + SOC2 excerpt) to the drive folder and updated the evidence spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1NovaEvidenceSheet — column 'uploaded_by' filled and redaction notes in the comments.

ben (sre): Added availability graphs and DR runbook to the folder. Note: internal IPs and account IDs have been masked per redaction guidance.

rebecca (solutions): Quick question on Q34 (KMS rotation): does the customer want the rotation schedule or the rotation policy? I can extract a short snippet from the runbook.

mike-sec (security): Provide both: policy + schedule snippet. We'll redact specific dates but show cadence (monthly/quarterly), rotation owners, and evidence of automated alerts. I'll attach a redacted policy excerpt.

audrey (sales-eng): Customer also asked for a penetration-test summary (executive) — not the full report. Is a 1-page exec summary acceptable?

mike-sec (security): Yes. Upload the 1-page exec summary with a note that the full report is available under NDA. Mark it as `nova_pen-test-execsummary_v1.pdf`.

ana (sales): Anything blocking final packaging? Deadline EOD Tue for the handoff.

rebecca (solutions): No blockers from my side; waiting on security redactions for two screenshots.

mike-sec (security): On it. Will finish redactions and produce a final index row mapping Q12/Q34/Q78 -> artifacts. Ping me if you need the raw files for review. :lock: 

ana (sales): Thanks — once uploaded I'll create the ZIP and share a short cover note. Appreciate the quick turnaround, team.
